source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's Sterling campus publishes 116 megawatts of IT capacity across three facilities, making it the second-largest declared data center power budget in Virginia.

The campus concentrates 7.2 percent of Virginia's published data center capacity in one site, with 1.18 million square feet of technical space. At a typical AI training density of 40 kilowatts per rack, that capacity could support roughly 2,900 accelerator racks, but the operator's specifications do not state actual tenant equipment or utilization.

Only 25 of 330 mapped Virginia data centers publish power figures, so Sterling is one of the few sites where capacity can be read directly rather than inferred. The published specifications omit total power draw, PUE, cooling technology, grid interconnection details, and expansion constraints, so whether this campus is currently limited by grid availability in Northern Virginia is not stated.
